title: Tandoori Chicken
description: Whole chicken marinated in a spiced yoghurt tandoori marinade with ginger, garlic and warming spices, then roasted or slow-cooked until tender.

ingredients.text: 2 onions, peeled and each cut into 3 thick slices
1 tsp cayenne pepper (leave out if you like your tandoori mild)
1 garlic clove, peeled and finely grated
5cm (2in) piece of root ginger, peeled and grated
a few drops of red food colouring (optional)
Garlic Mushroom Biryani (here), Cheese and Onion Mash (here) or Balsamic Roasted

steps: Juice the half lemon into a bowl, then place the squeezed lemon half inside the chicken cavity.
To make the marinade, mix all of the spices together with the salt in a large non-metallic bowl (big enough to contain the chicken).
Add the garlic, ginger, lemon juice, soy sauce, red food colouring (if using) and yoghurt and mix well.
Place the chicken in the bowl and coat it with the mix. Loosen the skin around the breast by sliding your fingers between the skin and the meat, and rub the marinade onto the chicken under the skin.
Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for a few hours or overnight.
Place the sliced onion pieces on a baking tray.
the marinated chicken on the baking tray on top of the onions, cover with foil and roast in the preheated oven for 50 minutes, then remove the foil and cook for a further 30 minutes.
Check the chicken is thoroughly cooked by sliding a knife into the thickest part of the leg. Your chicken is cooked when the juices run clear.

Put the sliced onion at the bottom of the slow cooker.
Place the chicken on top of the onions in the slow cooker and put the lid on.
Cook on high for 4½ hours or 9 hours on low.  “I’m finally getting my love for cooking back.”                                                   SAM
